_about: English source for the Android app (English only). Edit this file, then run: node android/scripts/gen-strings.mjs . Placeholders are %1$s style.

strings.about_credit: Coucou for Android, by Rhytam Biswas. Part of Coucou by Louis Raillé.
strings.licences_intro: The code of Coucou is MIT-licensed. The name, the character, the icon and the sounds are Louis Raillé's and are not. The libraries are listed with their licence.
strings.about_assets: The name Coucou, the Mochi character, the icon and the sounds are © Louis Raillé and used with permission. The Android code is © Rhytam Biswas, released under the MIT License.
strings.widget_description: Who is working and what waits for you.
strings.widget_solo_description: Mochi and your most urgent agent.
strings.widget_list_description: Every agent and what it is doing.
strings.widget_big_description: Mochi, your plan usage and quick buttons.
strings.widget_pill_description: Your most urgent agent on one line.
strings.widget_alert_description: Calm, until an agent needs your approval.
strings.widget_ring_description: How much of your Claude or Codex plan is used.
strings.widget_mood_description: Just Mochi's face, in your agents' mood.
strings.widget_usage_off: Turn on plan usage in the app
strings.widget_big_usage_off_line: Turn it on in the app
strings.pairing_help: On your computer open Coucou, then Settings, Android phone, and scan the code it shows.
strings.pairing_credit: Coucou for Android, by Rhytam Biswas.
strings.paste_hint: Copy it from Coucou on your computer (Settings, Android phone).
strings.approval_on_computer: Answer this request on your computer. Allow is not offered here, because the whole command cannot be shown on the phone.
strings.approval_caution: Allow only if you asked for this.
strings.question_body: Answer it on your computer. To answer here, turn on "Let the phone answer Claude Code's questions" in Coucou on your computer (Settings > Android phone).
strings.question_not_sent: The answer could not be sent. Your computer may have answered already.
strings.home_empty_hint: Start an agent on your computer and it shows up here.
strings.discovery_body: Is the phone on the same Wi-Fi as the computer? Is the computer awake, with Coucou running and the phone link on, and does Windows allow Coucou on private networks? Some hotspots and guest networks block devices from finding each other (client isolation).
strings.address_hint: For example 192.168.1.20 or 192.168.1.20:47821. Your pairing stays as it is: only the address changes.
strings.address_bad: That is not a valid address.
strings.chat_off_not_paired_body: Pair your computer first, then you can chat through it.
strings.chat_off_offline_body: Your computer cannot be reached right now. Check that it is on, with Coucou running, on the same Wi-Fi.
strings.chat_off_title: Chat is off on your computer
strings.chat_nomodel_title: Your computer has no model allowed for the phone yet
strings.chat_off_hint: On your computer open Coucou > Settings > Android phone, turn on "Let the phone chat with my AI providers" and tick a model.
strings.design_note: The building blocks of the new look. No other screen uses them yet.
strings.msg_not_pending: That request is no longer pending.
strings.msg_bad_link: That is not a Coucou pairing link.
strings.msg_rejected: The desktop rejected this phone. Pair again.
strings.msg_need_lock: Set a screen lock to approve from your phone.
strings.approval_hint: Allow on the phone asks for the fingerprint or the screen lock. Deny does not.
strings.overlay_hint: An island drops from the top of the screen while an agent works, then goes back up.
strings.msg_overlay_permission: Allow “display over other apps” for Coucou, then come back.
strings.notify_done: When an agent finishes or fails
strings.notify_done_hint: A quiet notice in the notification shade, and the pill if it is on. Permission requests and questions always notify you.
strings.quiet_hint: No sound and no pill for finished or failed agents. Requests and questions still come through.
strings.history_empty: Your decisions will appear here. They stay on this phone.
strings.history_note: Kept only on this phone, never sent anywhere.
strings.island_answer_on_pc: Tap to open Coucou, or answer on your computer
strings.overlay_missing: Allow “display over other apps” so the island can show.
strings.relay_use: Use the relay when I'm away
strings.relay_use_hint: Reaches your computer from mobile data or another network, through the relay you set up. Everything stays end-to-end encrypted. The direct link is always tried first.
strings.relay_line_off: The relay is off. Coucou only connects when your computer is on this network.
strings.relay_line_waiting: Looking for your computer. It will use the relay if it is not on this network.
strings.relay_line_access: The relay refused the access key. Check it in Settings on your computer.
strings.relay_line_taken: This pairing is in use somewhere else. Pair again from your computer.
strings.relay_line_rate: The relay is limiting connections for now. Trying again soon.
strings.relay_line_unreachable: Cannot reach the relay. Check your internet connection.
strings.relay_line_away: Your computer is not answering through the relay. It may be asleep or have the relay off.
strings.channel_link_description: Shows that Coucou is connected to your computer
strings.channel_updates_description: An agent finished, failed or has a question
strings.channel_approvals_quiet_description: A waiting request, kept in the shade while the pill shows it
strings.channel_approvals_description: An agent is waiting for your permission
strings.language_picker_hint: Pick the language of Coucou. From Android 13 you can also choose it in Android's own settings, under Apps.
strings.settings_dynamic_hint: Takes the surfaces and the text colours from Android (Material You). Mochi and the state colours stay the same.
strings.settings_motion_hint: System follows Android's Remove animations. When on, Mochi stops idling and the island and sheets simply appear.
strings.settings_no_wake: Don't wake the screen for a request
strings.settings_no_wake_hint: The request still arrives with its sound and its notification; only the screen stays dark until you look.
strings.settings_requests_note: A request is never muted or hidden: these only change how it buzzes and whether it lights the screen.
strings.settings_computer_none: No computer connected yet. You can pair one from the Home screen.
strings.chat_note: Uses your computer's API key. Your computer sends your messages to the provider you pick; the key never reaches this phone.
strings.chat_empty: Ask anything. Your message goes to the model you pick above the box.
strings.chat_clear_body: This removes the conversation from this phone and tells your computer to forget it.
strings.chat_ref_busy: Wait for the answer to finish, or stop it.
strings.chat_err_off: Chat is turned off on your computer.
strings.chat_err_not_allowed: That model is not allowed for the phone.
strings.chat_err_busy: Another answer is still being written.
strings.chat_err_rate: Too many messages. Try again in a few minutes.
strings.chat_err_no_key: Your computer has no key for that provider.
strings.chat_err_unreachable: Your computer could not reach the provider.
strings.chat_err_auth: The provider refused your computer's key.
strings.chat_err_connection: The connection to your computer was lost.
strings.session_hint: Turn on “Show session details on the phone” in your computer's Settings to see the steps and the last message here.
strings.session_ended: This session is no longer running.
strings.scan_hint: Point the camera at the code in your computer's Settings → Android phone.
strings.scan_not_pairing: That is not a Coucou pairing code
strings.scan_why: Coucou uses the camera only on this screen, to read the pairing code. Nothing is saved or sent.
strings.scan_blocked: The camera is off for Coucou. Turn it on in Android's settings, or paste the link instead.
strings.scan_camera_error: The camera could not start. Paste the link instead.
strings.pair_confirm_body: %1$s:%2$d on your network. Only pair with a computer you own.
strings.pair_confirm_relay: It can also reach your computer from other networks through the relay at %1$s. Only pair if you set up that relay yourself.
strings.pair_confirm_replace: This replaces the computer you are connected to now.
strings.wardrobe_note: Choose what Mochi wears on this phone.
strings.wardrobe_follow_hint: Mochi wears what you chose in Coucou on your computer.
strings.file_failed: Could not load this change. Check the connection and try again.
strings.file_gone: This change is no longer available on your computer.
strings.file_too_large: This change is too large to show line by line.
strings.file_truncated: Only the first 200 lines are shown.
strings.diag_intro: These checks find where the connection breaks. Nothing secret is shown or copied: the report hides the pairing code, the fingerprint, the computer's name and its full address.
strings.battery_title: Keep the connection while the screen is off
strings.battery_body: Android pauses background apps to save battery. If requests stop reaching you when the phone is locked, let Coucou run without restrictions. This is only a suggestion.
strings.lost_silent: The computer stopped answering. This is usual after the phone slept.
strings.lost_closed: The computer closed the connection. Coucou may have been closed or restarted there.
strings.lost_no_wifi: The phone is not on Wi-Fi. Join the network your computer is on, or use the internet link.
strings.lost_unreachable: The phone cannot reach the computer. Coucou may be closed there, its phone link may be off, or it is on another network.
strings.battery_step_samsung_1: Open Settings > Apps > Coucou for Android > Battery and choose Unrestricted.
strings.battery_step_samsung_2: Then Settings > Battery > Background usage limits: make sure Coucou is not in Sleeping apps or Deep sleeping apps (add it to Never sleeping apps).
strings.battery_step_generic: Open the app's battery setting and choose Unrestricted (or Don't optimise).
strings.glance_not_paired_detail: Open Coucou to connect to your computer
strings.widget_team_description: The agents you pick, side by side.
strings.team_config_hint: Pick up to %1$d agents. With none picked, the busiest ones show.
strings.share_not_paired: Pair your computer first, then you can send text to chat.
strings.share_chat_off: Chat is not available on your computer, so the shared text was not kept.
strings.mute_agents_hint: Finished, failed and limit notices of the agents you pick stay quiet. Requests and questions always come through.
